text: Welcome to training module seven, replacing a Lumio string inverter.
Step one. Switch off the AC isolator and lock it off before you touch anything.
Step two. Open the DC isolator at the string combiner.
Step three, and this is the one people skip. Wait five minutes after isolating before you open the inverter lid. The capacitors inside stay charged.
Step four. Confirm zero volts across the DC terminals with a meter rated for the job.
Step five. Release the MC4 connectors with the proper release tool. Never use pliers.
Step six. Two M8 bolts hold the bracket. Support the unit as you remove the second one.
Step seven. Torque the DC terminals to four point five newton metres with a torque driver.
Step eight. Re-energise in reverse order: DC first, then AC, then confirm the site is reporting in the portal.
